why: Both land on a mail-room hedgehog with profit per customer, flag the POS write-off, the free-license decree and long-run electronic substitution for mail, but Analysis 2 sits closer to the key by rejecting profit per meter, framing the stop-doing rule as not chasing markets led by bigger firms, and leaving room to widen to the business back office. Analysis 2 is also slightly better calibrated, stating what evidence would overturn its copier and price-marking calls and admitting it could not schedule the re-check, while Analysis 1 has a marginally fuller brutal-facts table (it lists copiers explicitly).
